voxelparticles.config.title: Voxel Particles
voxelparticles.config.enabled.tooltip: Turns flat sprite particles into small 3D models with real thickness.
voxelparticles.config.motion.billboard.t: Particles always face you, like in vanilla. Thickness is only visible near the screen edges.
voxelparticles.config.motion.sway.toolti: Particles stay upright and slowly rock from side to side, so you can see their thickness.
voxelparticles.config.motion.spin.toolti: Particles rotate around the vertical axis, like dropped items.
voxelparticles.config.motion.tumble.tool: Particles roll around in every direction. Looks the most 3D, but shapes are harder to read.
voxelparticles.config.depth.tooltip: How thick particles are. 1.0x makes every pixel a cube.
voxelparticles.config.shading.tooltip: How much darker the sides are than the front, like block faces. 0% means flat color.
voxelparticles.config.motion_speed.toolt: How fast particles sway, spin and tumble.
voxelparticles.config.lod_distance.toolt: Particles farther away are drawn flat to save performance. Tiny particles are always flat.
voxelparticles.config.max_resolution.too: Largest model size per side. Sprites from high-resolution packs are scaled down to this to keep the game fast.
voxelparticles.config.tumble_debris.tool: Block and item crumbs tumble in the air and land flat on the ground.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.voxelpart: Makes every particle 3D, even modded ones.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.voxelparticle: Makes every particle 3D, even modded ones.
